scope: GameInput v0 factory and polling through a TuxBox provider. A private X display supplies real key and mouse transitions. Controller and retail-title evidence are recorded separately.
reproduction: Build with python build.py gameinput. On a private desktop, launch gameinput-control.exe --private-desktop-report result.txt through the selected host and focus the TuxBox GameInput control window. The guest injects a key and a mouse click. For the original control place the same guest beside the packaged DLL in a separate directory.
checks: R press and release with virtual key and scan code
forward and backward reading ordering filtered by the keyboard device
retained snapshots after live state changes
relative mouse movement by 11 and 7 counts, left press and release
